You can get gang members for your crew.  The more respect you have, the more gang members you can have.

== Total Respect ==

Your total respect is calculated as follows:

* [[#Running Respect|Running Respect]]: '''40%'''
* [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Walkthrough|Mission advancement]]: '''36%'''
* [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Territories|Territories]] owned: '''6%'''
* Amount of money: '''6%'''
* Muscle (physical fitness): '''4%'''
* [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Dating|Progress with girlfriend]]: '''4%'''
* [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Appearance|Appearance]]: '''4%'''

== Running Respect ==

Running respect is everything you do in general, which is amounted as thus:

* Killing a drug dealer: '''+.005%'''
* Killing a rival gang member: '''+.5%'''
* Killing one of your gang members: '''&ndash;.0005%'''
* One of your gang members dies: '''&ndash;2%'''
* [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Territories|Territories]] won: '''+30%''' (a major part of the Los Santos section of the game)
* [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Territories|Territories]] lost: '''&ndash;3%'''
